children: Singapore media services firm's full-year revenue was S$6.1 mln, up slightly yr/yr
Profit for the year attributable to owners rose 33% to S$1.09 mln
Company's tax expense rose to S$0.2 mln
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods
INCREASED REVENUE - Company's hotel operations business contributed $5.8 million through the Klaven Hotel Myeongdong City-Hall, while the investment income contributed a total of $0.3 million
INVESTMENT ALLOCATION – Investment income rose to S$0.3 mln from S$0.1 mln as increased equity and debt investments generated higher returns than fixed deposits
HIGHER TAX CHARGE – Tax expense rose to S$0.2 mln due to tax on hotel dividends remitted to Singapore and reversal of deferred tax assets
